_about: Asides: at most one per entry, and often none. Each one is picked only when its conditions match.
weather, when (parts of the day: late night, dawn, morning, afternoon, evening, night) and drink are lists; an empty list means any.
A name is listed under a condition only when it matches; no aside is repeated until the ones that match are used up.

asides.text: It's raining enough to justify using an umbrella, but somehow Parisians don't.
It's drizzling so subtly I almost didn't notice.
It's pouring outside and I'm glad I'm in here with a nice hot beverage.
It doesn't snow much in Paris, perhaps today will be a lucky day.
The sky is clear enough to see the lamps on the far side of the city.
The Eiffel Tower is especially beautiful on sunny days like this.
The lamps are on now. There's a lot of chatter from the bar across the street.
Earl Grey has a faint perfume of bergamot, as though someone opened a window in London.
The matcha is very green. I'm told that's good for me, so I'm trying not to think about it.
